observations: I opened assets/panels/03-5.png, checkin-patients.png and main-cast.png with Read. From screen-left to screen-right, Mr. Raman, Priya and Ravi sit side by side on blue waiting chairs. Each matches their sheet: Raman's glasses, white hair and brows and cream shirt; Priya's ponytail with scrunchie, hoop earring, coral kurti, jeans and crossbody bag; Ravi's beard, brows, green shirt and watch.
Raman's hands match production: his right hand holds the walking stick upright beside his knee and his left hand rests on his knee.
Priya's hands match production: her left hand holds her phone in her lap and her right hand rests on the armrest.
Ravi's hands match production: his right hand holds his phone at chest height and his left hand, with the watch, rests on the dark-brown shoulder bag on his lap.

The wall TV in the upper-right corner covers roughly the right third of the panel width and the top third of its height. It shows a plain light-teal screen with one wide empty white strip, with no text or numbers, ready for the lettered slot list.
All three look up toward the TV with small satisfied smiles, which reads as calm and reassured. Two background patients are seen from behind. Plain wall at upper left for the caption.
